text: COP31, the UN climate conference, is held in Antalya, Türkiye.
The UN Secretary-General has issued a Call to Action on Extreme Heat.

sources.label: United Nations: Extreme heat: the UN Secretary-General's Call to Action, 2024

text: At the 2025 UN climate conference (CMA 7), countries adopted a set of 59 Belém Adaptation Indicators to measure progress towards the targets for adaptation; reporting on them will serve as an input to the global stocktake.
